originalTitle: The Hood: The World is His | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
content: From the shadows of the New York underground comes the newest power-hungry villain. 🔥 Cloaked in a cursed mantle, Parker Robbins lost his faith in heroes alongside his father and his world's Captain America - replacing it with an insatiable appetite for the power to change the world. Stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, he remade himself as the feared crime lord, The Hood. Now, The Hood treads a perilous path through channeling dark magic, devouring enemy firepower, and transforming into a demonic abomination of cosmic magic and steel. Even after a deadly clash in Thebes with Gambit and Doom 2099 over the Tablet of Death and Entropy, his dark journey is far from over... 📅 Season 9.5 arrives on August 7th, 2026 UTC!
